title: Introduction to Computer Programming and Algorithms: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
unitTitle: Introduction to Computer Programming and Algorithms
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B

parts.text: Define the term algorithm and explain the characteristics of an algorithm.
Explain the advantages of flow charts in program development.
What is the output of the following C programs?

main() { char x; int y; x = 100; y = 125; printf("%c
", x); printf("%c
", y); printf("%d
", x); }
main() { int x = 100; printf("%d\n", 10 + x++); printf("%d\n", 10 + ++x); }
Describe the program compilation process.
Define any four types of operators used in programming.
Describe the problem solving/program life cycle.
Develop the algorithm and represent it using the pseudo code required for a program to calculate the sum of 10 numbers.
Discuss the criteria for selecting a programming language.
Discuss the program compilation process.
Write a program in C that accepts two numbers, checks whether they are equal or not and reports the outcome on screen.
Differentiate between the while and do-while statements.
A program is required to accept the length and width of a square and display its area.
Write a pseudo code and draw a flow chart to represent the solution to the problem described above.
Write a program that accepts the length and width of the square and displays its area.
Explain the types of variables found in a C program.
Using an example, explain the structure of a C program.
Explain the following terminologies used in a C program.
CASE selection
Looping control structure
Keyword
Describe the nested-if statement.
